<?php
/**
 * DatabaseSessionDriver - Cross-service authentication handler
 * Manages session persistence across microservice boundaries
 */
class DatabaseSessionDriver implements SessionHandlerInterface
{
    private $pdo;
    private $table;
    private $tokenLifetime;
    private $serviceRegistry;
    private $hmacKey;

    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4',
            $config['host'], $config['database']);
        $this->pdo = new PDO($dsn, $config['username'], $config['password'], [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
        ]);
        $this->table = $config['table'] ?? 'sessions';
        $this->tokenLifetime = $config['lifetime'] ?? 7200;
        $this->hmacKey = $config['hmac_key'];
        $this->serviceRegistry = $config['services'] ?? [];
    }

    public function open($savePath, $sessionName): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function close(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function read($sessionId): string|false
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT payload, last_activity, user_id FROM {$this->table} WHERE id = :id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $sessionId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$row) {
            return '';
        }

        if (time() - $row['last_activity'] > $this->tokenLifetime) {
            $this->destroy($sessionId);
            return '';
        }

        return $row['payload'];
    }

    public function write($sessionId, $data): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (id, payload, last_activity, user_id)
             VALUES (:id, :payload, :time, :uid)
             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload = :payload2, last_activity = :time2"
        );
        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;
        return $stmt->execute([
            ':id' => $sessionId,
            ':payload' => $data,
            ':time' => time(),
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':payload2' => $data,
            ':time2' => time()
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy($sessionId): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE id = :id");
        return $stmt->execute([':id' => $sessionId]);
    }

    public function gc($maxLifetime): int|false
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE last_activity < :threshold"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':threshold' => time() - $maxLifetime]);
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    /**
     * Cross-service token exchange - validates incoming service token
     * and binds it to the current session context
     */
    public function handleCrossServiceAuth(string $serviceToken): bool
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $serviceToken);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        [$header, $payload, $signature] = $parts;

        // Verify HMAC signature
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $header . '.' . $payload, $this->hmacKey);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature)) {
            return false;
        }

        $data = json_decode(base64_decode($payload), true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['sub'], $data['iss'], $data['exp'], $data['sid'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate token expiry
        if ($data['exp'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate issuing service
        if (!in_array($data['iss'], $this->serviceRegistry, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Bind the cross-service session: adopt the upstream session ID
        // to maintain session continuity across services
        $upstreamSessionId = $data['sid'];
        $this->migrateSession($upstreamSessionId, $data['sub']);

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Migrates current session to align with upstream service session.
     * Preserves session data while establishing cross-service binding.
     */
    private function migrateSession(string $targetSessionId, string $userId): void
    {
        $currentData = $_SESSION ?? [];
        $currentData['user_id'] = $userId;
        $currentData['authenticated'] = true;
        $currentData['auth_time'] = time();

        // Adopt the upstream session identifier for cross-service consistency
        session_id($targetSessionId);
        session_decode(session_encode());

        $_SESSION = $currentData;
        $_SESSION['cross_service_bound'] = true;
    }

    /**
     * Generate a service token for outbound cross-service requests
     */
    public function generateServiceToken(string $targetService): ?string
    {
        if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || !$_SESSION['authenticated']) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!in_array($targetService, $this->serviceRegistry, true)) {
            return null;
        }

        $header = base64_encode(json_encode(['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'SVC']));
        $payload = base64_encode(json_encode([
            'sub' => $_SESSION['user_id'],
            'iss' => gethostname(),
            'aud' => $targetService,
            'exp' => time() + 300,
            'sid' => session_id(),
            'iat' => time()
        ]));

        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $header . '.' . $payload, $this->hmacKey);

        return $header . '.' . $payload . '.' . $signature;
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$config = require __DIR__ . '/config/session.php';
$driver = new DatabaseSessionDriver($config);
session_set_save_handler($driver, true);
session_start();

// Handle cross-service authentication if token present
if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_SERVICE_TOKEN'])) {
    $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_SERVICE_TOKEN'];
    if ($driver->handleCrossServiceAuth($token)) {
        header('X-Auth-Status: bound');
    } else {
        header('X-Auth-Status: rejected');
        http_response_code(401);
    }
}
